interpretation: Source/CI test success is not full contract acceptance. This is an evidence gap inventory, not a change to the owner ledger. PASS only means the owner ledger already marked A04/A05 PASS. All other cases keep their NOT_RUN status until real evidence and independent acceptance review.

evidence_baseline.disclaimer: Real disposable-service CI and native source builds, not proof of production staging, signed physical devices, providers or cutover.

cases.title: Product/source freeze
cases.remaining_proof: Run approved four-theme and accessibility/device screenshots against the final V5 native and browser builds; publish exact difference/exception register.

cases.title: Baseline and CI
cases.remaining_proof: Review final merged SHA and V4 protected tags against exact-head Node, PostgreSQL, native and all 12 workflow reports; sign off the original A02 contract.

cases.title: Reported backup conflict
cases.remaining_proof: Independently inspect the latest V4 encrypted backup, perform a fresh isolated restore and compare current backup freshness/status to the earlier outage.

cases.title: Environment and role isolation
cases.remaining_proof: Already PASS in owner ledger; preserve verified separate service roles and regressions at release SHA.

cases.title: Migration framework
cases.remaining_proof: Already PASS in owner ledger; retain checksummed migrations, exclusive migrator and no-DDL runtime validation.

cases.title: Complete source coverage
cases.remaining_proof: Re-inventory live SQLite source immediately before cutover, capture final schema/root fingerprint and classify any new durable source fields.

cases.title: Per-actor reconciliation
cases.remaining_proof: Repeat exact per-actor wallet, receipt, identity, privacy and relationship reconciliation on the FINAL frozen source; retain negative swapped-wallet check.

cases.title: Deterministic restartable import
cases.remaining_proof: Confirm interrupted and repeated final import is deterministic with real frozen production snapshot, time boundary and non-UUID source IDs.

cases.title: Escrow and ledger
cases.remaining_proof: Review source-linked per-actor liquid/reserved/escrow accounting and replay legacy journal in final import; preserve zero unexplained differences.

cases.title: Concurrent spending
cases.remaining_proof: Review P04/P07/P09 concurrency and same-actor reservation races against deployed final Core/PG; verify no double charge or altered timing.

cases.title: Atomic result and payout
cases.remaining_proof: Review fault-injection and final wallet/result/rating/outbox traces with deployed final Core; confirm exactly-once payout and rollback.

cases.title: Shared actor identity
cases.remaining_proof: Exercise real email, Google and Apple sign-in/linking on old browser and physical Android/iOS; prove stable actor hash across platforms.

cases.title: Refresh and revocation
cases.remaining_proof: Exercise real device refresh races, old-token replay, revocation and active socket/key rotation under configured provider sessions.

cases.title: One-use realtime tickets
cases.remaining_proof: Record dual-Core one-use ticket redemption and negative wrong-session/env/audience outcomes in integrated staging.

cases.title: Redis complete loss
cases.remaining_proof: Wipe isolated stage Redis during active match, paid queue and pending effects; capture PG hashes before/after plus rejoin and latency metrics.

cases.title: Matcher concurrency
cases.remaining_proof: Capture final staging multi-matcher, heartbeat expiry and dead-worker races; verify durable assignment and reserved Crowns.

cases.title: Committed move recovery
cases.remaining_proof: Kill one real Core before/after commit/publish/ACK and reconnect via the other live process; capture revision and outage duration.

cases.title: Clock correctness
cases.remaining_proof: Run exact deadline move/timeout and restart/reconnect boundary on the deployed Core/PG clock source.

cases.title: Transport recovery
cases.remaining_proof: Test real Android/iOS backgrounding, offline/reconnect, reordered notifications and HTTP fallback against staging.

cases.title: Tournament behavior
cases.remaining_proof: Exercise full public/private tournaments through real stage workers including host-leave cancel, dead-worker recovery and payout/escrow parity.

cases.title: Jobs and outbox
cases.remaining_proof: Run actual provider I/O crash/retry/DLQ failure scenarios with workers in integrated staging; record idempotent external effects.

cases.title: UTC scheduled economics
cases.remaining_proof: Record duplicate scheduler and UTC week/quarter catch-up through staging and check unique business operations and approved reward periods.

cases.title: Vercel/Core ownership
cases.remaining_proof: Attempt forbidden API/worker wallet writes and forged service HMAC/actor assertions against REAL deployed Vercel/Core staging.

cases.title: Retained browser compatibility
cases.remaining_proof: Exercise shipped old-origin browser cookie, account session exchange, callback routing, CSRF and match/economic flows on real V5 staging.

cases.title: Cache correctness and privacy
cases.remaining_proof: Verify real cross-worker block/invalidation, stale read projections, Redis wipe and actor-separated cache headers; no authorization from caches.

cases.title: Private operations and audit
cases.remaining_proof: Probe public/private ops and audit endpoints from outside actual staging and verify dedicated-key audit chain under concurrency.

cases.title: Operational diagnosis and alerting
cases.remaining_proof: Inject a staging fault and verify end-to-end support trace and DELIVERED alert, not just simulated telemetry or liveness.

cases.title: Independent restore
cases.remaining_proof: Restore real encrypted off-host R2 backup into independent PostgreSQL project; measure RPO/RTO, hashes, revocations and cleanup.

cases.title: Process vs host availability
cases.remaining_proof: Prove real active-game Core process failover, then separately document same-host edge/power failure and true RTO.

cases.title: Immutable release compatibility
cases.remaining_proof: Deploy immutable components in allowed skew sequence, verify image digests and perform PostgreSQL-compatible application rollback on staging.

cases.title: Capacity and degradation
cases.remaining_proof: Run realistic mixed traffic on deployed topology; record p95/p99, connection/storage budgets, backpressure, recovery and alerts.

cases.title: Real native artifacts and offline bundle
cases.remaining_proof: Build, SIGN and install real Android/iOS artifacts; offline cold launch and inspect assets, bridge manifest and hashes.

cases.title: Native bridge security
cases.remaining_proof: Execute native untrusted-frame/navigation and storage/backup extraction attempts on physical devices; inspect real token exposure.

cases.title: Native purchases and restore
cases.remaining_proof: Exercise all four Crown products with sandbox purchase/cancel/pending/replay/refund/restore and backend ledger grant proof.

cases.title: Ads and consent
cases.remaining_proof: Run real UMP/consent and ad SDK tests, reward SSV replay/delay and prohibited-screen checks on device.

cases.title: Native accessibility and parity
cases.remaining_proof: Capture 4 themes, TalkBack/VoiceOver, keyboard/notch/small-screen and real network lifecycle on both device families.

cases.title: Distribution and review truthfulness
cases.remaining_proof: Verify real authorized signing and provider consoles; preserve uploaded/submitted/reviewed/approved/enabled as separate states.

cases.title: Single writer and first-write fence
cases.remaining_proof: During APPROVED cutover window fence all V4 writers, reconcile final import, record exact epoch and first V5 application write, prove no split-brain.

cases.title: Rollback classes
cases.remaining_proof: Run documented pre-write abort and post-write PG-compatible recovery on actual release topology; attach immutable operator artifacts.

cases.title: Retirement and scaling discipline
cases.remaining_proof: AFTER real G22, verify irreversible V4 writer retirement, preserved archives/client compatibility and measured capacity triggers.
